capabilities: Add a graph view to .base files alongside table views
Expand results by depth following links, backlinks or both
Colour notes by base groups and custom property-matching groups
Draw links from chosen properties for hierarchies and dependencies
Embed graph views in notes via base embeds and inline base blocks
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later with the Bases core plugin enabled; view options and group colours are saved in the .base file and can be edited by hand.
intentEvidence: Adds a Graph view to Obsidian Bases.
problem: The Bases core plugin only offers table-style views, so there is no way to visualise a base's filtered results as a graph.
summary: Adds a Graph view to Obsidian Bases, drawing a base's results as a force-directed graph with depth expansion, group colours and layered layouts.
